integration_rules: Never mutate or renumber MC-* identity.
A calendar day does not by itself prove an optional/local preceding or following rite occurred.
Object states are independent from posture states.
Requiem is a variance overlay on the certified Mass form: MR62 Ritus XIII expressly states everything else is as in other Masses.
Asperges faithful Sign of Cross is a personal ACTUALLY_SPRINKLED cue, never a chant-word trigger.
Corpus Christi procession is optional/local and must be explicitly activated; the feast date alone does not assert that a procession follows.
